summary.en-US: Create a Fastmail Masked Email alias for the site you are on in one click, copied straight to your clipboard, and see which alias you used where.

description.en-US:
A toolbar button for Fastmail's Masked Email.

Open it on a sign-up page and click "Create alias and copy". A new alias is made for that website and put on your clipboard, ready to paste.

**Remembers where each alias went.** The popup lists the aliases you have already used on the current site, and a search tab finds any alias by address, website or note. You can copy, disable or re-enable aliases from there too.

**Works with aliases made elsewhere.** The website is saved on the alias in Fastmail itself, so aliases created on your phone or by a password manager show up as well.

**Signing in.** Paste a Fastmail API token with Masked Email access (Settings, Privacy & Security, API tokens).

Requires a paid Fastmail account. This is an independent project and is not made or endorsed by Fastmail. The source code is on GitHub.

version.approval_notes: Testing needs a Fastmail account and an API token with Masked Email scope (Fastmail Settings > Privacy & Security > API tokens). The only network destination is https://api.fastmail.com. Source is attached; to rebuild: Node 24, `npm ci && npm run build`, output in dist/. The build is not minified.
